summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for:
1. Accessible In-Call PIN Authorization (Dual Mode: DTMF keypad and Spoken PIN alongside Handset Push) for visually impaired and elderly users during institutional/telco demonstrations.
2. Complete privacy redaction with **** masking in chat/logs and strict zero-logging of credentials.
3. Surgical fix of the ASR Acoustic Filter Gate in echoFilter.ts and useSpeechRecognition.ts to eliminate speech mangling by restricting echo filtering strictly to active assistant audio playback windows.
